Priya K: quick heads-up — company all-hands this Thu 10:00am PT. short agenda: 1) product roadmap highlights (15m) 2) policy update: hosted API data-retention & PII handling (10m) 3) ops launch callouts for ded. capacity (10m) 4) live Q&A and rapid takeaways :wave:
Jordan L: will the policy update include changes to logs retention?
Priya K: yes — we'll outline a move to 90-day rolling logs for hosted prod, and a new default PII-redaction step in the ingestion pipeline. will share slides + config snippets.
Alex M: can we get the deck after the meeting? I have to hop on another call.
Priya K: absolutely — slides + transcript posted after. Recording + captions will go up within an hour.
Samira R: adding a few Qs for the Q&A: (1) rollout timeline for retention changes? (2) will customers be opt-out/opt-in? (3) implications for Dedicated contracts?
Ken S: ops note — for Dedicated customers we'll surface an opt-in toggle in console; default for Hosted is the new retention. we'll detail migration plan and support windows.
Megan T: can we include an example config snippet for the PII filter? e.g. ```json
{"pii_redaction": {"enabled": true, "ruleset": "email-phone"}}
```
Priya K: good call, Megan — we'll show the snippet and an example rollout timeline (2-week gradual rollout, monitoring checkpoints).
Jordan L: also please mention the fallback for capacity spikes — folks relying on older model variants should know how we route to compatible variants.
Ken S: noted. I'll add the routing fallback diagram and the A/B rollback playbook to the ops slide.
Samira R: accessibility request — can we enable live captions and make the transcript downloadable? some folks need that.
Priya K: yes — enabling live captions. RecordingBot will post the transcript link after the meeting.
ops-bot: reminder scheduled — All-Hands: Thu 10:00am PT — Priya K presenting — reminder in 24h and 1h before meeting.
RecordingBot: will upload recording + transcript to #all-hands after meeting ends. expected links: Recording (youtube internal) + /docs/all-hands/mar-ops-briefing.pdf
Alex M: tiny ask — can we also include a brief two-bullet "what you need to do" for eng teams re: retention change? makes it easier to share.
Priya K: yes — slide will have a "What engineers need to do" slide with checklist + opt-out steps for Dedicated customers.
Samira R: Q: will there be any billing impact for Dedicated customers who opt into longer retention?
Ken S: short answer: no immediate billing change. if customers request extended retention beyond 90 days we'll surface pricing options.
Priya K: thanks everyone — drop any other questions in this thread and we'll triage into the live Q&A. see you Thu. :thumbsup:
